# Techpoint Africa

> Techpoint Africa is Africa's leading platform for startup news, fintech innovation, and tech ecosystem coverage, tracking African entrepreneurship, policy, and digital transformation.

Techpoint Africa provides daily news, analysis, and insights on African startups, fintech, renewable energy, and tech policy. The platform combines news coverage with original series like After Hours interviews and Equity Merchants podcast, serving as a central hub for understanding Africa's tech landscape.

## Key Topics

- African startups
- Fintech and mobile money
- Venture capital and startup funding
- Nigeria tech policy
- African tech ecosystem
- Social media regulation
- Renewable energy and IoT
- Digital innovation
- M-Pesa and payments
- Emerging markets
- Tech governance and compliance
- African tech infrastructure

## Core Topics & Hubs

- [Homepage](https://techpoint.africa): Main hub covering African startup ecosystem, fintech, and tech news
- [Fintech](https://techpoint.africa/subject/fintech): Topic hub covering African fintech, payments, mobile money, and financial services
- [Startups](https://techpoint.africa/subject/startups): Topic hub covering African startups, funding, and entrepreneurship
- [Governance & Policy](https://techpoint.africa/subject/governance-policy): Topic hub on African tech regulation, compliance, and policy impact
- [Renewable Energy](https://techpoint.africa/subject/renewable-energy): Topic hub on solar, clean energy tech, and IoT in renewable sectors

## Newsletters & Digests

- [Techpoint Digest](https://techpoint.africa/subject/techpoint-digest): Weekly tech roundup newsletter for African and global tech updates
- [Newsletters Hub](https://techpoint.africa/newsletters): Hub for Techpoint newsletters including Digest, Equity Merchants, and How Things Work
- [Safaricom tackles fraud risks with M-Pesa update](https://techpoint.africa/insight/techpoint-digest-1305): Digest article on Safaricom's M-Pesa security update and fintech news
- [South Africa's Competition Commission to probe Showmax shutdown](https://techpoint.africa/insight/techpoint-digest-1304): Digest article on Showmax investigation, AI policy, and tech taxation in Africa

## Audio & Interview Series

- [Equity Merchants](https://techpoint.africa/series/equity-merchants): Podcast series on venture capital, equity investing, and African startups
- [After Hours](https://techpoint.africa/series/after-hours): Founder interview series spotlighting African tech builders and innovators
- [Work Life](https://techpoint.africa/series/work-life): Series on Nigerian workplace experiences, careers, and work-life balance
